title: The worker covers each numbered acceptance clause with a red-to-green test and Stop refuses an uncovered clause
body: Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-direction-1115c.md slice 3. Outcome: brief splits the task body into numbered clauses; worker records per clause a test red on base and green on commit or a written not-reproducible; Stop refuses an uncovered clause. Proof: pre-registered K vs K+clauses, 2 reps on py-sweep, py-fs-sweep, controls py-dict-updates, py-barrel-list; adopt if py-fs-sweep mean rises >=1 case, no row lower, cost <=1.5x. ~$2.5. Code: src/cli/lane-brief.ts, src/hook/stop.ts.

How to run the arm (code merged, default off): set KRN_ACCEPTANCE_CLAUSES=1 in the lane env. The brief (lane-brief.ts) then appends numbered Acceptance clauses plus the red-to-green rule; Stop (hook/stop.ts) reads the clauses from tasks/<KRN_TASK>.json body, else from env KRN_TASK_BODY (set it to the row body for outside rows), and refuses while a clause lacks a changed test containing 'clause N' that fails at base and passes on head, or a commit line 'Clause N: not reproducible: <reason>'. Bodies with <2 clauses are never refused. Pair with KRN_TEST_FIRST unset for arm K+clauses. Measurement is still open: serial lane must wire the env in scripts/outside-acceptance.ts and run the pre-registered proof.
